name: synthetic-dataflow-bigquery
description: Generate fictitious-but-realistic synthetic rows for a BigQuery table via Apache Beam + L4 GPU + Gemma 4. See docs/DEPLOYMENT_PREREQUISITES.md.

parameters.name: ddl_uri
parameters.label: DDL JSON URI
parameters.helpText: gs:// path to a _ddl.json — the OFFLINE FALLBACK only (ADR 0027 D2). Live extraction is authoritative at every launch: structure from reference_table, description surfaces (llm_prompt_constraint + relational contract) overlaid from landing_table — the SOURCE table's descriptions are stripped, never used to steer generation. Extract the pin from the LANDING table; it is consumed only when live extraction fails (air-gap, BQ outage), with staleness reported via ddl_pin_drift / ddl_pin_fresh.

parameters.name: reference_table
parameters.label: Reference table FQN
parameters.helpText: Source BigQuery table for live SELECT reference rows. project.dataset.table.

parameters.name: reference_rows_limit
parameters.label: Reference rows LIMIT
parameters.helpText: Cap on rows pulled by SELECT ... LIMIT N. Default 10000.

parameters.name: landing_table
parameters.label: Landing table FQN
parameters.helpText: Destination BigQuery table for valid synthetic rows. project.dataset.table.

parameters.name: dlq_table
parameters.label: DLQ table FQN
parameters.helpText: Destination BigQuery table for dead-lettered rows. project.dataset.table.

parameters.name: num_rows
parameters.label: Number of synthetic rows to generate
parameters.helpText: Positive integer.

parameters.name: initial_workers
parameters.label: Initial worker count
parameters.helpText: Initial Dataflow worker count (ADR 0034). Empty = Dataflow's default; the 2026-08-29 R6 pair started on 2 workers and autoscaled to 4 only ~4 min into the first generate stage. A 10M-row run should start at its maxWorkers. Must not exceed maxWorkers.

parameters.name: autoscaling
parameters.label: Worker autoscaling mode
parameters.helpText: auto (default): a fleet sized by initial_workers stays that size (autoscaling NONE), otherwise Dataflow's THROUGHPUT_BASED. fixed: same pin, initial_workers required. throughput: always scale. The 2026-09-07/08 multi runs lost ~4 min per job to mid-job scale-downs between the parent and child stages (ADR 0034 D9).

parameters.name: batch_size
parameters.label: Batch size per generate_batch call
parameters.helpText: Records per LLM batch. Default 16.

parameters.name: similarity
parameters.label: Similarity to reference (0.0–1.0)
parameters.helpText: 0=pure random within schema, 1=mimic reference closely. Default 0.5.

parameters.name: run_id
parameters.label: Run ID
parameters.helpText: Unique identifier propagated to validation_runs and reference_digest provenance.

parameters.name: identity_cols
parameters.label: Identity columns
parameters.helpText: Comma-separated per-row-unique columns synthesized fresh each row (PK/UUID); never sampled from reference data. Optional; empty means no identity-column synthesis.

parameters.name: pk_cols
parameters.label: Primary-key columns
parameters.helpText: Comma-separated declared primary-key columns; duplicate PK tuples divert to the DLQ (rule_id=pk.duplicate, BLOCKER). Optional; empty means PK not declared.

parameters.name: engine
parameters.label: Generation engine
parameters.helpText: b1_rag (RAG over reference rows) or b2_library (CTGAN/SDV-family wrapper).

parameters.name: model_uri
parameters.label: Model URI
parameters.helpText: gs://<bucket>/synthetic/models/<family>/<model>/<version>/.

parameters.name: embedder_uri
parameters.label: Embedder URI (B.1 RAG)
parameters.helpText: gs://<bucket>/synthetic/models/embedders/<model>/<version>/ — optional; empty uses the dependency-free HashingEmbedder.

parameters.name: rag_chunks_table
parameters.label: RAG chunk-store table FQN (B.1)
parameters.helpText: project.dataset.table of synthetic_rag.rag_chunks. Enables the read-instead-of-reembed path; with build_rag_layer=true also enables population. Optional; empty disables the chunk store.

parameters.name: build_rag_layer
parameters.label: Populate the RAG chunk store
parameters.helpText: true/false. Populate rag_chunks from this run's reference sample (skipped when the reference_digest already exists for the embedder id+version). Requires rag_chunks_table.

parameters.name: validation_runs_table
parameters.label: validation_runs table FQN
parameters.helpText: Destination BigQuery table for the run-level summary row. project.dataset.table. Optional; empty skips the write.

parameters.name: env
parameters.label: Environment tier
parameters.helpText: dev | uat | prd — selects the threshold tier from config/thresholds.yml.

parameters.name: thresholds_uri
parameters.label: Thresholds file URI
parameters.helpText: gs:// or local path to thresholds.yml selecting the pass/fail gates for the run's env tier. Default: config/thresholds.yml.

parameters.name: client_type
parameters.label: Model client type
parameters.helpText: vllm (production), mlx (M4 local smoke), fake (CI fixture).

parameters.name: vllm_dtype
parameters.label: vLLM serve dtype override
parameters.helpText: auto (default) = checkpoint dtype (bf16 for Gemma/Qwen). float16 = explicit downcast REQUIRED on T4 for fp16-safe bf16 checkpoints (Qwen); refused for gemma-family models.

parameters.name: vllm_max_model_len
parameters.label: vLLM max-model-len cap
parameters.helpText: Caps the KV-cache context allocation. Without it vLLM sizes for the checkpoint's native context (Qwen3-2507: 262K needs 36GiB KV and kills the T4 EngineCore at startup). Default 8192 fits every registry model/GPU pairing. Empty = no cap.

parameters.name: seed
parameters.label: Explicit base RNG seed
parameters.helpText: Explicit base RNG seed (integer) for deliberate reproduction of a run. Empty (default) derives a fresh seed per (run_id, batch) — recommended.

parameters.name: write_disposition
parameters.label: Landing write disposition
parameters.helpText: append (default, WRITE_APPEND) or overwrite (WRITE_TRUNCATE). Landing table only; DLQ/quality/RAG tables always append.

parameters.name: create_if_not_exists
parameters.label: Create landing table if missing
parameters.helpText: true/1/yes: CREATE_IF_NEEDED carrying the derived landing schema. Default false (CREATE_NEVER).

parameters.name: freetext_pools_table
parameters.label: Free-text pool store table
parameters.helpText: project.dataset.table of synthetic_rag.freetext_pools. Enables the read-instead-of-rebuild path; with build_pool_layer=true also enables the build branch. Optional; empty disables the pool store.

parameters.name: build_pool_layer
parameters.label: Build the free-text pool store
parameters.helpText: true/false. Build free-text pools in their own branch and persist them (skipped when this reference_digest already exists for this model_uri). Requires freetext_pools_table.

parameters.name: pool_seed_strategy
parameters.label: Free-text pool seed strategy
parameters.helpText: centroid (control, densest region) | kcenter (seeds span the column's modes) | kcenter_rotate (re-seeded per ladder attempt; forfeits vLLM prefix caching by design).

parameters.name: uniqueness_mode
parameters.label: Uniqueness enforcement mode
parameters.helpText: exact (default) diverts every duplicate to the DLQ behind ONE full-row shuffle barrier (PK/identity rules resolved from key-only groups, ADR 0034). exact_chained keeps the pre-ADR-0034 three-barrier chain (row digest -> PK -> identity) for A/B runs. streaming lands rows as they are generated and measures the duplicate rate instead; duplicate rows LAND, the run is still marked FAILED_BLOCKER, so re-run with write_disposition=overwrite.

parameters.name: fk_fanout_stats_table
parameters.label: FK fan-out stats table FQN
parameters.helpText: project.dataset.table for synthetic_data_quality.fk_fanout_stats (ADR 0036 cache of the SOURCE fan-out histogram + PK cells per driving edge). Empty (default) = measure every launch, never cache.

parameters.name: fk_candidate_cap
parameters.label: FK candidate cap
parameters.helpText: ADR 0037 — max candidate tuples per shared key for a conditional FK edge; a driven child's PK-completing members must cover the source fan-out within this cap. Default 64.

parameters.name: on_model_conflict
parameters.label: On a measured model conflict
parameters.helpText: ADR 0038 — what a MEASURED contradiction between the relationship model and the SOURCE does. adjust (default) = drop the declared pk: the full-source fan-out proves is not a key, announce it in the MODEL ADJUSTED banner, emit the effective model as YAML, and carry on; the landing table then reproduces the source's key-repeat share and that table's pk.duplicate stops counting toward the BLOCKER gate. stop = refuse the launch, as before ADR 0038. Model self-contradictions and the ADR 0035 capacity gate stop under both settings.

parameters.name: driven_uniqueness_mode
parameters.label: Driven-child uniqueness mode
parameters.helpText: Uniqueness mode for a DRIVEN child without identity columns (ADR 0036): its PK is unique by construction, so streaming (default) measures duplicates without the landing-path barrier. exact / exact_chained are available for A/B runs, same semantics as uniqueness_mode.

parameters.name: freetext_expansion
parameters.label: Free-text shape expander
parameters.helpText: off = pool draws only (distinct capped at pool size). identifiers (default) = code-like columns expand from their observed shape mix, breaking the pool-size distinct ceiling. all = also mutate digit runs inside texty pool draws. Never adds an LLM call (2026-08-05 spec C3).

parameters.name: prompt_constraints
parameters.label: Per-column LLM prompt constraints
parameters.helpText: on (default) attaches each column's llm_prompt_constraint (parsed from its DDL description JSON) to the pool prompt as a constant, prefix-cache-safe suffix. Columns without a constraint are untouched — with none anywhere, 'on' is a no-op (spec C5).

parameters.name: prompt_debug
parameters.label: Pool-prompt debug logging
parameters.helpText: off (default) logs nothing. redacted logs each built pool prompt as a freetext_pool_prompt milestone with seed exemplars elided (<k seeds elided>) plus a sha12 prompt hash. full logs verbatim prompts at WARNING — reference values reach Dataflow logs, short-lived debug runs only (ADR 0024 §3c).

parameters.name: source_stats
parameters.label: Source-table stats computation
parameters.helpText: sample (default) computes per-column source_table_stats from the reference sample driver-side (zero DAG cost); exact adds ONE aggregate scan of the live table (HLL distinct, deciles, top-k) and feeds exact distinct into free-text pool sizing (ADR 0022); off disables entirely (WS8 spec WS-B).

parameters.name: source_stats_table
parameters.label: Source stats BQ table
parameters.helpText: project.dataset.table for source_table_stats rows; empty/omitted skips the BQ write (stats still land as milestone + JSON artifact). Existing (table, digest) rows are never rewritten. Never auto-created: bq mk from config/bq_schema/synthetic_rag/source_table_stats.schema.json.

parameters.name: source_stats_json
parameters.label: Source stats JSON artifact path
parameters.helpText: gs:// or local path for the per-run stats JSON artifact; empty/omitted skips it.

parameters.name: fk_parent_landing
parameters.label: FK parent landing dataset
parameters.helpText: EXPERT OVERRIDE only (ADR 0029): parents are assumed landed in the landing dataset and this derives automatically. Set only when parents land in a DIFFERENT project.dataset.

parameters.name: generate_fk_relationships
parameters.label: Generate FK relationships
parameters.helpText: true (default): declared relationships are honored — the launch expands to the whole FK component, parents first, everything derived. Tables with no relationships behave exactly as false. false: isolated generation; declared edges ignored LOUDLY. ADR 0029.

parameters.name: relationships_uri
parameters.label: Relationship models URI
parameters.helpText: Where the relational models live (ADR 0032): a folder or a single YAML file, local or gs://. Default: the config/relationships folder packaged in the image. Point it at gs://... to change PK/FK/identity without rebuilding — this is the ONLY source of relational truth; table descriptions are never read for it.

parameters.name: multi_table_mode
parameters.label: Multi-table execution mode
parameters.helpText: single_job (default): every planned table in ONE Dataflow job — one worker fleet, one vLLM ignition, in-DAG FK key handoff (ADR 0030). sequential_jobs: one job per table, parents first (fallback/debugging).
